build_simulator_config: build a habitat_sim.Configuration from a settings dictionary using make_cfg for simulator initialization
create_sensor_specs: create pinhole, fisheye, equirectangular, or orthographic camera sensor specs via make_cfg settings flags
configure_navmesh: configure navmesh settings with agent radius and height using the default_agent_navmesh setting in make_cfg
customize_physics: customize physics simulation by enabling bullet physics and setting a physics config file in make_cfg
review_default_sim_settings: review the default_sim_settings dictionary to understand available simulator configuration parameters and sensor options
